name: The S-1 Filing: Prismview Analytics IPO
description: Graduate-level five-round simulation of taking a Boston B2B SaaS analytics company public on NASDAQ. Teams navigate positioning and comp selection, S-1 disclosure and risk-factor drafting, road show and price talk, SEC comment-letter response, and live pricing night to maximize a composite Deal Quality Score across issuer proceeds, disclosure integrity, book quality, allocation quality, and Day 1 aftermarket performance.

Round 1 — Positioning and Comp Selection

Deal Decisions

Defensibility beats optics. Pick what an institutional PM would accept.
TSC v. Northway / Basic v. Levinson materiality. Would a reasonable investor consider this important?
ISS and Glass Lewis will publish voting recommendations. Dual-class and staggered boards draw red flags.
Book is 2.8x covered at midpoint. Quality of book beats coverage.
Staff is pressing. Your response must be consistent with the Round 2 disclosure choice.
Staff asserts $4.8M of Q3 revenue should have been ratable, not upfront.
CEO wants $24. Anchor LOs scale back above $23. Loughran-Ritter documents ~15% median IPO underpricing.
